fact: A national workshop at Ebolowa on 3-14 November 2025, under the World Bank-supported PATNUC project, gave technical validation to the draft law (avant-projet) on access to public information and digital transformation of the administration, now ready for ministerial and institutional finalisation; the report was published 21 January 2026.
system: Réforme e-Gov sur l'accès à l'information publique et la transformation numérique de l'administration (avant-projet de loi)

fact: PATNUC's 20 November 2025 explainer describes the e-Gov reform on access to public information and digital transformation of the administration as one of the texts examined at the Ebolowa 2025 workshop, with provisions on default access, proactive publication and appeal routes, and states no promulgation.
system: Réforme relative à l'accès à l'information publique et à la transformation numérique de l'administration (loi e-Gov)

fact: The document is the published draft text (avant-projet de loi) of a Cameroon law on the right of access to and use of public information and on the digital transformation of the administration, with chapters on proactive publication, access on request, a Mediator and exceptions; no date is given for the draft, so its published date of 2023-05-22 is used.
system: Avant-projet de loi relative au droit d'accès et d'utilisation relatif à l'information [publique] et à la transformation numérique de l'administration
